title: Chapter 701 - 701 Lin Chengzhen Goes To School; Heavenly Eye!

Chapter 701 - 701 Lin Chengzhen Goes To School; Heavenly Eye!

Chapter 701 - 701 Lin Chengzhen Goes to School; Heavenly Eye!

701 Lin Chengzhen Goes to School; Heavenly Eye!

After a few days of happiness, the family came to the Path-Understanding Tree.

Under Lin Fan’s explanation of the laws, skills, and cultivation methods, Lin Xiaoyao, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, and the others’ cultivation levels were all rising rapidly.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue had already entered the Incarnation Realm and had at least tens of thousands of years of lifespan.

Lin Xiaoyao, Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, and the others had all entered the Transcendent Realm and could live for at least several thousand years.

Moreover, their cultivation was still steadily increasing.

In the short term, they did not have to worry about their lifespan.

However, they did not slack off in their cultivation because of this.

They understood that only by working hard could they keep up with Lin Fan’s footsteps.

…

In the blink of an eye, another three years had passed.

Lin Fan relied on his continuous cultivation and comprehension to obtain a large amount of experience points.

Even though he had yet to break through to level-two of the Domain Lord, he had also taken a big step forward.

In these three years, the system had rewarded Lin Fan with the Protection Pearl (Emperor), Heaven and Earth Enlightenment x2, Shifting Shadow Saint Technique (Emperor Grade), Xuanhuang Breathing Technique…

Today, Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Qiu Ziqian, and everyone else stopped cultivating and ate a sumptuous family banquet.

Today was the day Lin Chengzhen officially went to school.

With Lin Fan’s current strength and influence, he could easily invite the best teachers in the world.

However, he still decided to let Lin Chengzhen go to school and make friends like a normal child.

Lin Fan felt that this was something that children had to experience.

Otherwise, there would be regrets in life.

“Chengzhen, don’t be afraid in school,” Lin Xiaoyao said. “If anyone bullies you, tell me! I’ll definitely teach them a lesson!”

“It’s a little difficult for others to bully Chengzhen,” said Chu Yunyue with a smile.

Chu Yunyue was absolutely not spouting nonsense.

One had to know…

Lin Chengzhen had lived in the Coiling Dragon Villa, which was filled with spiritual energy, since he was young.

Moreover, he was often personally guided by Lin Fan.

Now, his cultivation had reached the Hundred Destruction Realm.

On Earth, there were very few people who were his match.

Furthermore, Lin Fan had also given the Protection Pearl to Lin Chengzhen.

It was no exaggeration to say that even if the earth shattered, Lin Chengzhen would not be hurt at all.

Under such circumstances, how could anyone bully Lin Chengzhen?

Furthermore, Lin Fan’s spiritual power could easily cover the entire Earth. That was why Lin Chengzhen would not get bullied.

Chu Yunyue bent over and smiled. “Lil Chengzhen, don’t bully others. Of course, if someone provokes you, don’t hold back.”

“Lil Chengzhen, be careful.”

Xia Xue said, “Lil Chengzhen, good luck!”

“Lil Chengzhen, you can do it!” Xia Bing said.

…

Lin Chengzhen’s bright black eyes stared at Lin Fan, Hu Tian, Chu Yunyue, Lin Xiaoyao, and everyone else for two seconds before he said in a strong and serious tone, “Daddy, Mommy, Second Mother, Third Mother, Fourth Mother… Aunt, don’t worry, I’ll be careful!”

Then, he turned around and boarded the aircraft, heading straight for the school dozens of kilometers away.

Although everyone knew that Lin Chengzhen would definitely not be in danger, they still could not help but look at the flying device’s shadow as it left.

It was Lin Fan who said, “Don’t worry, I’ll take care of him.”

When everyone heard this, they retracted their gazes.

…

Jiangbei First Primary School.

When the children arrived at the classroom, they chattered non-stop like sparrows, looking very excited.

Lin Chengzhen was silent.

He quietly took out a pen and paper and prepared for class.

At this moment, a little boy with a buzz cut walked in from outside and jumped onto the podium, stirring up a strong wind.

This action shocked all the students in the classroom.

The little boy did not care at all. He put his hands in his pockets, glanced at the students, and said coolly, “My name is Li Hao. From today onward, I’m your boss!”

The students blinked, still at a loss.

Li Hao said again, “In the future… If anyone is in trouble, you can look for me!”

Then, he jumped off the podium, not caring whether the students understood him or not.

However, Li Hao soon faced his nightmare.

“Boss, I didn’t bring toilet paper!”

“Boss, I don’t know how to do my homework.”

“Boss, help me with my homework.”

“Boss, my dad hit me!”

…

“From today onward, I’m not the boss anymore. Don’t look for me in the future!”

…

In the blink of an eye, several years passed.

On this day, a powerful aura burst forth from Lin Fan’s body.

He let out a long sigh. “Finally, I’ve reached level-three Domain Lord.”

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, it’s been 30 years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. You’re rewarded with the Eye of Heaven, Transcendence Golden Body x1, Immortal Crystal x1.]

[Eye of Heaven: Able to see other people’s attacks and weaknesses in advance. It’s a very magical skill.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up as he praised sincerely, “As expected of the Eye of Heaven. It’s simply a cheat! But I like it.”

His eyes flickered with a faint golden light, as if he had the power to see through everything.

Then, a Transcendence Golden Body that looked exactly like him appeared in front of Lin Fan.

The two of them nodded at each other.

Finally, Lin Fan willed it out, and a white Immortal Crystal appeared before him.

An extremely dense and pure energy that he had never experienced before instantly swept through the entire room.

Lin Fan used the Xuanhuang Breathing Technique to take in a deep breath. Instantly, a large amount of energy surged within his body.

This breath actually exceeded the energy he had gained from circulating the breathing technique a dozen times before!

Lin Fan could not help but praise, “There’s such pure spiritual energy in the Immortal Crystal!”

He was more confident in protecting his family and living a long and happy life with them in the future.

However, before Lin Fan could celebrate for too long, the Earth, which had been peaceful for a long time, suddenly let out a huge sound.

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Domain Lord level detected.]

[Xing Yu: Level-Two Domain Lord. A core disciple of the Sky Thunder Sect. He accidentally discovered the stone sized Earth and thought it was a rare treasure, hence his greed.]

Lin Fan raised his head slowly and saw a two-meter-tall man wielding a huge blade. He was looking at Earth greedily.

Then, he raised his saber again and slashed at the earth.

There was another loud noise.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, and the others, who were cultivating peacefully, stopped and looked around with worried eyes.

Lin Fan said, “Don’t worry, it’ll return to normal soon.”

After saying that, he leaped and turned into a stream of light, instantly breaking through the clouds.
